tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥ mchog gi dang po'i mgon po rtag pa'i dpal/ / sems nyid rin chen rdo rje rnam bzhi yi/ /lam gyis rab sbyangs sku bzhi mngon gyur pa/ /chos kun mnyam nyid ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /sku bzhi dbyer med yan lag bdun ldan sku/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mi bdag sprul pa'i sku/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten mgon pos rjes bzung dus zhabs pa/ /de yi zhabs brten dus zhabs gnyis pa dang*/ /rgyal sras chen po nā lend+ra pa la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga phul byin zla mgon zhabs/ /'jig rten mig 'byed 'bro ston shes rab grags/ /rdo rje theg pa'i srog shing dkon mchog srungs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub sngags 'chang sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ /grub pa'i khyu mchog mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs/ /chos kyi dbang phyug ma lus chos kyi bdag /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo mtshar bgrangs bcas ma cig sprul sku dang*/ /nam mkha' 'od zer mtshan 'chang mkhas pa'i phul/ /sngon gnas rjes dran grub thob se mo che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i shes rab 'od zer dang*/ /rab gsal rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul dge steng pa/ /srog 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mthar son kun spangs rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon mkhyen thogs med rgyal ba ye shes dang*/ /mkhas btsun grub brnyes yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ /rigs ldan sprul sku kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /legs bshad rin chen 'byung gnas nya dbon dang*/ /grub chen 'gran zla med pa'i kun blo ba/ /nges don bstan pa'i srog shing dkon mchog bzang*/

/gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mdo sngags kun chub nam mkha' chos skyong dang*/ / mkhas dbang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ /lo chen mtshan 'chang ratna bha dra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thogs med brtul zhugs grub pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gnyug ma mngon gyur lung rigs rgya mtsho dang*/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /gsol 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gsol ba 'debs so kun mkhyen jo nang ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gro drug byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon 'gro dben pa gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs shing*/ /dngos gzhi yan lag drug gi sbyor ba yis/ / mthar thug sku bzhi rdo rje rnam pa bzhi/ /myur du mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes sbyor drug jo nang lugs kyi brgyud 'debs tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / sngon sbyangs mkhyen pa'i rin chen rgya mtsho dang*/ /thar pa'i lam ston blo gros rnam par rgyal/ /grub pa'i mchog gyur ngag dbang 'phrin las zhabs/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin rlobs/ /mtha' 'khob mun sel ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang*/ /dam chos dga' ston spel mdzad dar rgyas mtshan/ / rgyal ba kun dngos 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rang bzhin lhun gyis grub// zab lam mthar phyin 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang*/ / dus 'khor brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong 'di'ang sprul sku 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis ri khrod du thun mtshams su bris pa'o/ / rigs kun khyab bdag chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rim gnyis mthar son chos kyi 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul zad kun dga' dpal ldan rje/ / dbang lung gdams ngag mdzod 'dzin chos 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/

/gnas lugs gshegs snying mngon gyur mkhas grub dbang*/ /yi dam zhal gzigs bstan pa gsal byed zhabs/ /rgyud sde rab 'byams spro bsdu rdo rje bzang*/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /spyod 'chang rnam 'phrul dkon mchog dar rgyas rje/ /gzhan stong 'dzam gling khyab mdzad blo gros grags/ /drin can mngon gyur rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / dus 'khor brgyud 'debs kha skong 'dzam thang gtsang chen gzim khang bde chen bshad sgrub dpal gyi pho brang gi gdan rabs rim byon ltar blo bzang chos 'phel bas bris pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 5-- PAGE 3 -
